description: This file defines a generic interface 'BaseMapper' used for mapping between entity objects and Data Transfer Objects (DTOs). It provides methods to convert lists of entities to DTO lists, individual entities to DTOs, and DTOs back to entities.

classes.name: BaseMapper
classes.description: A generic interface for mapping between entity objects and DTOs with methods to convert between these types.

methods.name: toDtoList
methods.description: Converts a list of entity objects to a list of DTOs.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a single entity object to its corresponding DTO.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a DTO back into its corresponding entity object.
